annotations.title: Download a built page as files

description: Uses no credits. Packages a finished page as a zip that runs on any static host: index.html with every image it uses pulled into assets/, plus a README and metadata.json. Returns a download link. share_page gives a link to look at instead. It also returns implementation_prompt: step by step instructions for putting this page live on the user's own site. Postclick hosts a built page only for a live test, which the user starts in the app, so this is how a page goes live for good. platform tailors the steps to WordPress, Webflow and other builders. The builder steps stop at a draft for the user to publish.

platform.description: Where the page goes live. "host" is the simplest for any site: the page on its own subdomain (go.example.com) at a web host such as Hostinger, Netlify or Vercel, and the zip's CLAUDE.md holds every step. Omit if unknown and the instructions will assume nothing.
